climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A wine area around the Charente and Charente-Maritime departments, the Cognac country, where Ugni Blanc, grown mostly for distilling, covers about 96% of the vineyard area. Pineau des Charentes sits within it.
